thread:
sasha: Heads-up — prepping the airgap delta for private v1.4.3. Signing + shrinkwrap scheduled in ~2h. Need packaging sign-off and a short canary window.
packaging-bot: artifact uploaded: rw-private/v1.4.3/delta.tar.gz (size 48MB) SHA256: 3a7f8c9d...
deploy-bot: staging manifest published for v1.4.3 -> manifests/rw-private-v1.4.3.json
leon: Can we run a 1-hour canary against 2 private customers (custA, custB)? Watch installer success rate + post-install health-checks.
maya: +1 canary. Rollback criteria: installer failure rate > 2%, checksum mismatch on >0 installs, or post-install service failing health probes for >5m.
aj: Reg pin plan: we’ll publish shrinkwrap tag `rw-private-v1.4.3-shrink` and pin image refs in the manifest. If we need to rollback we’ll repoint shrink tag to `rw-private-v1.4.2-shrink` and block customer updates.
packaging-bot: cosign signature created by key:key-ops-2024. Command used:
```
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/keys/key-ops-2024 rw-private/v1.4.3/delta.tar.gz
```
sasha: Who has access to the key? Confirm no key rotation during rollout.
oncall-eng: I have access and no rotation scheduled during the window. KMS audit will show sign event.
leon: Quick checklist: 1) artifact signed 2) manifest pinned 3) canary targets ready 4) rollback tag pre-created 5) release notes / ops playbook linked.
aj: Release notes draft posted: https://internal/redwood/releases/notes/v1.4.3-private — includes known upgrade caveats for airgap installs.
packaging-bot: shrinkwrap tag `rw-private-v1.4.3-shrink` created and immutable flag set.
maya: Change window preference? Ops wants low-traffic window tonight 23:00-01:00 UTC. Can we do canary start at 23:10 UTC?
sasha: Works for me. I’ll trigger canary at 23:10 and open the metrics dashboard.
oncall-eng: I’ll standby for alerts. If installer success < 98% at 23:30, we abort and flip pins.
leon: Add a final manual hold step at 23:40 before full rollout. If everything green we proceed to wider push at 23:45.
sasha: Agreed. I’ll do the handoff at 22:30 UTC to ops for monitoring and to the oncall for rollback authority.
deploy-bot: canary deployment started at 23:10 UTC -> targets: custA, custB. Monitoring link: https://observability/internal/canaries/2045678901
packaging-bot: signature verified by deploy cluster: OK.
maya: Watching logs — install logs look clean so far. No checksum mismatches on first 8 installs.
aj: Preparing rollback tag now so we can flip fast if needed.
leon: If we hit rollback we’ll pin manifest to `rw-private-v1.4.2-shrink` and notify customers immediately. Ops playbook: https://internal/redwood/playbooks/airgap-rollback
sasha: Thanks all — I’ll post a short summary after canary completes. :thumbsup:
packaging-bot: final note: recorded signer fingerprint: 2B:4F:8A:... stored in release metadata.
deploy-bot: canary completed at 00:05 UTC. Results: installs attempted 48, success 48, post-install health probes OK. No rollback required.
sasha: Great — proceeding with wider rollout at 00:10 UTC. I’m toggling pins now and will update release notes with final artifact checksums.
maya: Thanks everyone.
